Tests cover positive and negative amounts and currencies with different fractional precision. ### Changes **Money conversion** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Float conversion and precision coverage**
`pkg/money/money.go`, `pkg/money/money_test.go`, `.changes/money-float-minor-units.json`|`NewFromFloat` scales amounts using the resolved currency's fraction and decimal arithmetic. Tests cover truncation toward zero and USD, JPY, and KWD precision. The changeset declares a patch release.| **Estimated code review effort:** 2 (Simple) | ~8 minutes Change: Bug fix
Merge Risk: Moderate · up to 98ca5

Exchange transfers that omit a destination amount can now come out one cent lower than before, because the amount is computed in floating point before conversion. Very large integer amounts can also change slightly. Resolve the transfer fallback regression before merging.
